The name Lailan is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and timeless significance

It signifies the night and evokes the imagery of calmness, serenity, and the beauty of the dark hours. In many Middle Eastern societies, the name Lailan is popular, reflecting the value placed on the night and the importance of peaceful reflection and rest.

The name Lailan can therefore be seen as a reminder of this spiritual journey and the importance of the night in nurturing one's spiritual growth.
